candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout; order was recently deployed at version 2.0.0 (from 1.0.0), suggesting a regression in the new order build.
candidates.uncertainty: Order metrics show 200s on /v1/orders and healthy postgres ops; the 500s may be intermittent or from a subset of instances. No order error logs captured to confirm the failing code path.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are caused by upstream order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, confirmed by correlated traces and gateway client logs. Order was recently deployed to 2.0.0, making a regression the leading bounded candidate; order-side error logs and status-split metrics are still needed to confirm the specific failure.
missing_evidence: Order service application error logs for the 500 responses on POST /v1/orders
Order metrics broken down by status (500 vs 200) and by instance/version to confirm error rate
Deployment timing correlation between order 2.0.0 rollout and onset of 500s
